confirmed_facts.statement: All 4125 observed AbilityName payloads are structured {Value: string}; no hash-only or dynamic-name case was observed.
The operation target and AbilityInherentTargetType are separate fields. Caster is the operation target in 4015 nodes, while 415 nodes explicitly supply an inherent target selector.

Black Swan Skill01 Phase01 launches Phase02 at OnStart[1] and camera at [2], both explicit true, before starting Skill01 animation at [3]. Phase02 first waits for Skill01=0.348, then damages, emits DamagePerformFinish, waits for 0.371 and emits SkillPerformFinish at [5].

Asta Skill03 Phase01 launches camera with explicit true at [2], Phase02 with the flag omitted at [3], then starts Skill03 animation at [6]. Omitted-flag Phase02 waits for Skill03=0.77, applies effects and emits SkillPerformFinish at [5].

AML_Minion01 Skill01 Phase01 launches Phase02 with explicit true before animation startup. Phase02 waits until 0.15 before SkillExecutionStart, later waits until 0.49 before damage/DamagePerformFinish and until 0.6 before SkillPerformFinish. Launch and explicit action-start marker occupy different source positions.

Saved TriggerAbility OnTaskBegin topology contains a direct call at 0xB99B801 to 0xE767290, identified by saved metadata as M499776 TurnBasedGameMode.AddWaitAbility. A preceding call site at 0xB99B7B8 targets M506457 TurnBasedAbilityComponent.FindAbilityInstance (0xE728DD0).
confirmed_facts.scope: Historical static call-site existence only. Saved 1024-byte linear window has no terminating ret; branch guard, arguments and reachability for true versus omitted are not captured.

confirmed_facts.statement: Saved TurnBasedGameMode metadata distinguishes _WaitingAbilityList, _ExecutingParallelAbilityList and _InsertAbilityList; AddWaitAbility/GetWaitingAbilityList are separate from AddExecutingParallelAbility.

Saved SkillPerformFinish executor M509173 (NLNBMBIHCGA.OnTaskBegin) has direct-callee entries 0xE6CDE60 = M506904 SkillCharacterComponent.SetSkillPerformFinish and 0xE74B3B0 = M506655 TurnBasedAbilityComponent.ResetCharmAction. This is call topology, not branch reachability, argument identity or event ordering; it does not show a direct ProcessOnAfterSkillPerformFinish call.

Saved AbilityInstanceState type T54569 declares EUnkonw, Ready, Executing and value__; no SUCCESS member. The scheduler finish packet writes SUCCESS to an explicitly supplied reference action task, not a recovered native ability state.

AddWaitAbility M499776 has one stripped-name parameter P458774 with type_reference 265335, also the return type_reference of get_OwnerAbilityRef M505656. FindAbilityInstance M506457 returns a different reference number 286703. Exact concrete type/wrapper conversion, parent/child origin and equality key are not resolved.

WaitSkillPerformAbilityFinish is a distinct config T22411 with zero declared fields, bridged to executor IAPDLAIIKHO T55946. Saved OnTaskBegin M509929 directly calls IsAllWaittingAbilitiesFinished M499778 (0xE7673A0); a separate Tick M509930 exists. Its predicate arguments, Tick body and task-success transition are not saved here.

Pinned Serpent caller has TriggerAbility(true) at OnStart[10], animation tasks at [11,12], WaitSkillPerformAbilityFinish at [14], then SkillPerformFinish at [15]. Pinned Sam caller has WaitSkillPerformAbilityFinish at [17] then SkillPerformFinish at [18]. Both wait operations are canonical OPAQUE nodes with empty arguments, null target and UNKNOWN event_boundary. Only this lifecycle sequence is examined; other operations are not analyzed.

Saved game-mode metadata has IsAllWaittingAbilitiesFinished overloads M499778 and M499779, _RefreshWaittingAbilityList M499890 and _IsAllWaittingAbilitiesFinished M499891. M499779 parameter type_reference=202024 matches get_OwnerEntity return type_reference; the specific filter and mutation are not established by the signature. No matching bodies for these consumers were found in the bounded saved raw-artifact search.

M509480 NAGBMNBECCI, previously a candidate launch helper, itself directly calls TaskContext.EvaluateTarget at saved site 0xB99BE5C. Its name or position after AddWaitAbility cannot identify it as child-start without its body.

Saved SkillExecutionStart M509166 has a direct callee M499784 TurnBasedGameMode.TriggerModifierAnySkillExecutionEvent (0xE767B80). Saved SkillPerformFinish M509173 has M506904 SetSkillPerformFinish (0xE6CDE60), plus patch-dispatch callees GetPatch/__Gen_Wrap_30. These establish event/perform and patch-dispatch surfaces, not actual taken branches, callback ordering or wait release.

Saved TriggerAbility config T22410 additionally declares AbilityInherentTargetPredicate and DynamicValues; SkillPerformFinish T22348 declares SkipAttackSettlement. Their defaults/guards are not recovered and the existing canonical distribution is unchanged. These are schema preservation/rejection requirements, not proven runtime family discriminators.

Saved T55022 SkillCharacterComponent metadata declares _SelfSkillPerformState F259373 (type_reference 608932), get_SelfPerformState M506958 (return reference 608937), and SetSkillPerformFinish M506904. Its parameter P465991 is reference 433618, not an identified wait-token parameter. The artifact contains declarations/signatures, not the setter body or a field-write link to waiting-list predicates.

reconstructed_conclusions.statement: Unique target resolution is insufficient to lower TriggerAbility universally as an ordinary synchronous behavior call. IsSkillPerform cannot be discarded as presentation or silently defaulted.
Represent the invocation receiver, inherent targets, callee Ability.TargetInfo, logical skill ownership and completion-marker ownership independently.
Ability phase and camera siblings triggered before the caller's animation task make run-callee-to-completion inlining an unsafe universal ordering rule.
reconstructed_conclusions.scope: Does not by itself prove new AV turns, queue priority, or whether callee startup is immediate.

reconstructed_conclusions.statement: Sampled phase launches need resumable/interleaved execution or an equivalent causal event model. Blocking the caller until callee completion would wait on an animation started only later by the caller; deleting waits would invert damage/animation order.
reconstructed_conclusions.limit: Does not settle immediate start-to-first-yield versus deferred startup.

reconstructed_conclusions.statement: Performance tracking is a TriggerAbility architecture dependency: the historical executor has an AddWaitAbility call path. Keep ability waiting separate from inserted-action queues and AV advancement.
reconstructed_conclusions.limit: IsSkillPerform guard of this call is UNKNOWN.

reconstructed_conclusions.statement: Flag presence alone does not determine marker ownership: omitted-flag Asta Phase02 issues SkillPerformFinish; sampled explicit-true camera OnStart bodies do not themselves contain that marker.
reconstructed_conclusions.limit: Absence of an explicit marker does not mean completion cannot be tracked elsewhere.

reconstructed_conclusions.statement: Do not mark an action EXECUTING at launch merely because IsSkillPerform=true: AML_Minion01 has a later explicit SkillExecutionStart after a wait.

Launch return, explicit wait barrier, ability execution lifetime and skill-perform finish must be represented as separate boundaries. Sampled caller progression is incompatible with a universal local await at TriggerAbility, while the explicit WaitSkillPerformAbilityFinish task supplies a separate completion-check site.

The leading architecture is nonblocking phase/camera launch with game-mode-visible ability-wait bookkeeping and an optional explicit aggregate barrier. Whether registration is conditional on IsSkillPerform, how much child work happens inline, and which scope the barrier joins remain unproved.

Do not complete every registered child solely by its own explicit SkillPerformFinish: sampled true camera bodies have no such marker; omitted-flag Asta Phase02 does. Perform completion ownership and each ability execution lifetime require independent contracts.

A generic parent-child completion join cannot be inferred from AddWaitAbility: its game-mode receiver and explicit aggregate wait consumer remain compatible with a wider entity/perform barrier. Multiple child launches are source-backed; a per-parent wait set and its multiplicity are not.
